scope: Scheduled jobs and monitoring: uptime-monitor, db-sync scrub, cron failure alerting, Prometheus coverage, nightly routine, keyword-eval, Cloudflare 429 to Railway egress.

findings.title: Prod uptime monitor has not run since 2026-10-28T21:11Z; its last run misread HTTP 429 as an outage and could not send the alert
findings.proposed_fix: Owner: restore the cron (redeploy uptime-monitor so railway.toml's cronSchedule applies, or set the schedule in service settings, then confirm that runs resume). Code: treat 429 and other non-5xx answers apart from real outages (retry with backoff, report 'rate-limited' rather than 'DOWN'), and add a dead-man's switch: the relay or another cron alerts when no uptime heartbeat has arrived in 15 min.
findings.regression_test: Stub-curl test for check.sh: 429x3 must not report the Worker domain as broken, and a 5xx with origin 200 still alerts. Watchdog check: if no '[uptime] ok' line in 15 min, raise an alert.

findings.title: Nightly prod→dev sync has failed 4 nights running: scrub.sql's *_enc loop NULLs fleet_proxies.url_enc, which is NOT NULL
findings.proposed_fix: In scrub.sql's _enc loop, handle NOT NULL columns: for fleet_proxies, the sealed URL is useless on dev anyway (dev has no prod FB_POOL_KEY), so either DELETE FROM public.fleet_proxies (fleet_slots.proxy_id and fleet_proxy_checks.proxy_id are ON DELETE SET NULL) or set url_enc to a sentinel the app treats as 'no login' and make the readers tolerate it. Generic option: in the loop, EXECUTE 'DELETE FROM %I WHERE %I IS NOT NULL' when attnotnull, after checking no RESTRICT FK points at the table. Also make db-sync fail visibly (exit code already non-zero — wire an alert, e.g. the uptime-monitor or a Telegram message, on a failed run).
findings.regression_test: Extend tests/sync-scrub.test.ts to insert one row into EVERY table that has a *_enc column (discovered from information_schema, as the sealed-columns check already does), including fleet_proxies, then run scrub.sql with empty search_path and assert it commits and every *_enc is NULL or its row is gone. docs/review-2026-10-31/repro/A5/sync-scrub-fleet-proxies.test.ts asserts the current failure.

findings.title: [cross-lane] Cloudflare answered 429 to the Railway uptime probe, for both the app and the alert relay, while origin was 200
findings.location: railway:uptime-monitor deployment f458bd19-04b6-417d-901c-1943ff492510 logs 2026-10-28T21:11Z; backend http log 2026-10-28T21:11:39Z /api/health 200 from 152.55.181.187
findings.proposed_fix: Cloudflare lane: exempt /api/health and the relay /alert from rate/bot rules for this probe (custom header or a WAF skip rule), or probe from somewhere other than Railway. In check.sh, treat 429 as 'probe throttled', distinct from DOWN.
findings.regression_test: check.sh against a fake endpoint returning 429: it should classify the result as throttled, not as an edge outage.

findings.title: Next-task long-polls and VNC sockets error on every prod deploy
findings.proposed_fix: On SIGTERM, answer held next-task polls immediately with 'nothing_due' (wake every hold) before server.close. Exclude long-poll paths from any latency alert.
findings.regression_test: Backend test: with a held next-task, calling the shutdown hook resolves the request with a 200 nothing_due within 1 s.

findings.title: Prod-environment uptime-monitor builds from branch dev, with no release gate
findings.proposed_fix: Point the production uptime-monitor at main, or document why dev is intended.

findings.title: Reddit tracker deploys carry no commit, healthcheck or draining window
findings.proposed_fix: Record the git SHA in an env/var or log line at deploy time (deploy script sets GIT_SHA). Set healthcheckPath=/health on the api service via a service-level override, since the shared railway.toml can't carry one.

findings.title: Dormant resources still running with unrotated or stale state
findings.location: railway:ebay-tracker/Postgres 4d7e3e25-6aad-4207-9a65-9e7ca105e4d6; railway:recycle-server-odoo-erp/recycle-odoo b3490140-f725-49e9-a4b9-41f6dbb5856e; railway:aio-manufacturing-solution env 71b749cb staged patch 0f1cd121
findings.proposed_fix: Owner: archive or delete the ebay-tracker project, or rotate its DB password; delete recycle-odoo if it isn't needed; discard the aio staged patch.

findings.title: Backend variable names drift from env.ts
findings.proposed_fix: Remove FLEET_IMAGE_AGENT and (after confirming init-admin isn't run at boot) ADMIN_PASSWORD from the runtime env. Either set the FLEET_MIRROR_* trio on dev or document local-copy mode. Mark COORDINATOR_ACCESS_* optional in AGENTS.md.

findings.title: Nightly Railway inspection routine has been blocked every night since at least 2026-07-14, yet each run reports SUCCEEDED; even unblocked, its prompt needs origin/dev, which the sandbox clone lacks
findings.location: RemoteTrigger trig_01W3wmHwWNUGr63STjr9e5UT, env env_01LUc7Gka7hUDXMtor55tYnf, last run cse_01LBzvMzLrheVx4xnowf9c4X (2026-10-31T06:09Z)
findings.proposed_fix: Owner: add a read-only RAILWAY_API_TOKEN network secret and allow backboard.railway.com in env_01LUc7Gka7hUDXMtor55tYnf. Edit the prompt to start with 'git fetch origin dev inspection-reports'. Have a blocked run end with a non-success outcome or a push title, so it is not counted as green.
findings.regression_test: After the change, list_runs/get_run_log on the next run shows a get-logs call returning data and a successful 'git rev-parse origin/dev'.

findings.title: Fleet host 10.10.60.14 is not scraped by Prometheus, so its down, disk and memory states never alert
findings.proposed_fix: Add 10.10.60.14:9100 to the node_exporter job in the homelab-monitoring repo's prometheus.yml, and confirm the 10.10.60.5→10.10.60.14:9100 route. Optionally add 10.10.60.14's cadvisor.

findings.title: UPS alert rules are dead: their exporter job 'cyberpower' is not a Prometheus target
findings.proposed_fix: Re-add the cyberpower exporter scrape job, or change UPSExporterDown to absent(up{job="cyberpower"}) so a missing target alerts.
findings.regression_test: promtool test rules case with no cyberpower series expects UPSExporterDown firing.

findings.title: ai-verdict-bridge cron on 10.10.60.14 is obsolete (every worker now ships to OpenSearch) and indexes 0 every 5 minutes
findings.proposed_fix: Owner: remove both cron lines on 10.10.60.14 and check the homelab VM the same way. This is not a login.
findings.regression_test: crontab -l on the host has no fleet-ai-bridge lines.

findings.title: [cross-lane] deploy-workers.sh puts GHCR_READ_TOKEN in the ssh command line
findings.proposed_fix: Pipe the token over stdin: printf '%s' "$GHCR_READ_TOKEN" | ssh … "sudo docker login ghcr.io -u '$GHCR_USERNAME' --password-stdin".
findings.regression_test: shellcheck plus a grep check that no '${GHCR_READ_TOKEN}' appears inside a quoted ssh command.

findings.title: Fleet host keeps 13.1 GB of superseded worker and agent images with no prune policy
findings.proposed_fix: Have the agent prune images not used by any rs-fleet- container after a successful release, or add a weekly 'docker image prune -a --filter until=168h' timer. Keep 0.14.7 while worker-60-14-2 exists.
findings.regression_test: Agent unit test: after a release completes, images not referenced by any container are removed.

findings.title: keyword-eval has failed every day since 2026-10-25 because the rs-monitor container it reads no longer exists
findings.proposed_fix: Retire the job (unload plist) or repoint it at the fleet's log source (OpenSearch fb-tracker-* per memory fleet-ai-verdict-logs) from trackers/facebook/. If retired, revoke the .claude-oauth-token in that checkout.
findings.regression_test: After the change, `launchctl print gui/501/com.recycleservers.keyword-eval` shows last exit 0 and a new reports/keywords-<date>.md, or the label is gone.
